definitions.population: 2011 age >=60 and DA041 positive and DC015 frequent
definitions.sleep: 2011/2015 DC015: 3/4 frequent; 1/2 nonfrequent; ≥3 days last week

groups.both_persist: pain and frequent restless sleep both reported positive
groups.sleep_only: frequent restless sleep changes to negative, pain remains positive
groups.pain_only: pain changes to negative, frequent restless sleep remains positive
groups.both_resolve: both change from positive to negative

definitions.outcome: 2018 DA023_W4 return route; last-IW month equals the same person's actual 2015 interview month; strictly ordered visit intervals; v1.1 proxy and invalid-outcome rules
definitions.prior_fall: 2011 DA023, self or assisted, preceding two years
definitions.extended: mood9 + chronic12 + walk100 + vision + memory; memory is self-rated memory

dta_value_labels.2: 2 Did not finish primary school but capable of reading or writing

formulas.B_M1_R: Y ~ C(Bgroup, Treatment(reference="both_persist")) + age_c + C(sex) + C(education_R) + C(rural) + C(prior_fall)
formulas.B_M2_R: Y ~ C(Bgroup, Treatment(reference="both_persist")) + age_c + C(sex) + C(education_R) + C(rural) + C(prior_fall) + mood9 + chronic12 + walk100 + vision + memory
